name: Kono Uta ga Owattara ~When This Song Is Over~
original_name: この歌が終わったら -When this song is over-
source:
This is the first game by hourglass. With graduation fast approaching, Motonaga is told by his classmate and love interest Mizuku that she has been called back for a second audition for Production Chaos Promotion along with his imouto Yura. She had applied for it because she likes singing and wanted to make a career out of it. He decides to support her. Both of them pass the audition, along with another cool girl Asuka, and they form a trio called Primo Amore. Motonoga wants to help them more and starts working part-time as the manager’s assistant. The producer decides to shoot their first PV at a quiet scenic spot named Ayashino, which is far away from the city and is accessible only via one road. However, strange things start happening...

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本作是hourglass的處女作。畢業在即，元永從既是同學、也是心上人的美津玖口中得知，她與他的妹妹由良都接到了Production Chaos Promotion的第二階段試鏡通知。美津玖因為喜歡唱歌、希望以此為業而報名，元永決定支持她。兩人和另一名冷靜的女孩明日香一同通過試鏡，組成名為Primo Amore的三人團體。為了提供更多幫助，元永開始打工，擔任經紀人助理。製作人決定前往遠離城市、只有一條道路能夠抵達的寧靜風景區綾篠，拍攝她們的首支宣傳影片。然而，怪事開始接連發生……

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
